skill.name: claude-d3js-skill
skill.description: Guidance and templates for creating custom interactive data visualisations with D3.js, including charts, SVG layouts, scales, colours, transitions, and interaction patterns.
skill.summary: Create custom interactive D3.js visualisations with reusable chart patterns and templates.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, JavaScript template literals, D3 data keys, or chart styling text. One low network dependency is confirmed because the documentation shows a remote D3 CDN script, and one semantic finding notes unsafe tooltip HTML interpolation for untrusted data.

remediation.issue: Tooltip examples interpolate data into HTML.
remediation.suggestion: Use tooltip.text(), create DOM nodes with text content, or sanitize values before using .html() with user-provided data.

remediation.issue: Documentation includes a remote D3 CDN script tag.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer package-managed D3 imports, or document pinned CDN usage with subresource integrity and offline fallback guidance.

static_findings.snippet: All modules (scales, axes, shapes, transitions, etc.) are accessible through the `d3` namespace.
- Use `.join()` instead of separate enter/update/exit selections
- `d3-patterns.md` - Comprehensive collection of visualisation patterns and code examples
- `scale-reference.md` - Complete guide to d3 scales with examples
- `colour-schemes.md` - D3 colour schemes and palette recommendations
- `interactive-template.js` - Template with tooltips, zoom, and interactions
- Ensure scales have valid domains (check for NaN values)
- Avoid unnecessary re-renders by checking dependencies

content.value_statement: Custom D3.js visualisation work requires many chart patterns and integration choices. This skill provides reusable guidance, templates, and references for building interactive SVG charts.
actual_capabilities: Guides D3 setup with ES module imports and CDN loading.
Provides chart structure patterns for margins, scales, axes, and SVG groups.
Includes examples for bar, line, area, stacked, grouped, heatmap, radial, tree, and network charts.
Explains interaction patterns for tooltips, zoom, pan, brushing, transitions, and dragging.
Documents D3 scale choices and colour scheme guidance.
Includes React component templates for basic and interactive charts.
limitations: It provides guidance and templates; it does not run or validate generated charts.
Examples assume familiarity with JavaScript, SVG, and D3.js concepts.
Tooltip examples that use HTML interpolation require sanitization for untrusted data.
It does not cover 3D visualisations; Three.js is recommended for that need.

use_cases.title: Build custom dashboard charts
use_cases.description: Create tailored charts when standard chart libraries cannot express the needed layout or interaction.

use_cases.title: Prototype product analytics views
use_cases.description: Design React-based chart components with D3 scales, axes, tooltips, and zoom behaviour.

use_cases.title: Create explanatory data graphics
use_cases.description: Prepare polished SVG visualisations for reports, research summaries, and public data stories.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Chart Starter
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a D3.js bar chart for this dataset. Include margins, scales, axes, labels, and a clear colour choice.

prompt_templates.title: Interactive Chart Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a React component that renders an interactive D3 scatter plot with tooltips, zoom, and selected point state.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Visual Encodings
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a D3 visualisation approach for this data and goal. Explain the scales, colour scheme, interactions, and tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Network Visualisation
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a force-directed network diagram with drag behaviour, labels, grouped colours, legends, and performance considerations.

output_examples.input: A request for a responsive stacked bar chart comparing monthly product metrics.
output_examples.output: A D3 implementation plan with grouped data handling, stacked series, band scales, axes, legend, and responsive sizing notes.

output_examples.input: A request for an interactive scatter plot inside a React app.
output_examples.output: A component-oriented response covering refs, D3 rendering lifecycle, zoom behaviour, tooltip state, and accessible labels.

output_examples.input: A request to improve an unreadable colour palette.
output_examples.output: A revised palette recommendation using D3 colour schemes, contrast guidance, and colour-blind safe alternatives.

best_practices: Define dimensions, margins, scales, and axes before drawing marks.
Use D3 for data calculations and SVG updates where it gives clear control.
Escape or sanitize user-provided values before placing them into HTML tooltips.
anti_patterns: Do not use D3 when a simple static chart library meets the requirement.
Do not redraw complex charts on every render without checking dependencies.
Do not interpolate untrusted data into tooltip HTML.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build custom D3.js charts, SVG visualisations, interactive diagrams, and React chart components.

faq.question: Does it include ready-to-use templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes basic and interactive React templates plus reference patterns for common D3 chart types.

faq.question: Can it help choose the right D3 scale?
faq.answer: Yes. The references explain linear, band, ordinal, time, logarithmic, and other scale choices.

faq.question: Does it support interactive behaviour?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers tooltips, zoom, pan, brushing, transitions, and drag interactions.

faq.question: Is it safe for untrusted data?
faq.answer: Use care. Tooltip examples that render HTML should sanitize or escape untrusted values first.

faq.question: Is this intended for 3D visualisation?
faq.answer: No. The skill recommends Three.js for 3D visualisations.
